title: 3 Leg Chatarunga Pose

tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to avoid straining your lower back

steps: Begin by placing your feet on a bench and positioning your hands on the floor close together, forming a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers. Hips raised towards the ceiling
Engage your core and ensure your body forms an inverted V shape with your legs and torso
Lower your head towards your hands by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body
Push through your hands to return to the starting position, straightening your arms. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and control
Ensure your hips stay raised and your legs remain straight to maintain the pike position
Perform the movement with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down

title: Decline Kneeling Push Up
summary: Begin by placing your knees on a step up and position your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart
steps: Begin by placing your knees on a step up and position your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart
Engage your chest and ensure your body forms a straight line from your head to your knees
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them at a 45-degree angle to your body
Push through your hands to return to the starting position, straightening your arms. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Avoid flaring your elbows out to the sides; keep them at a 45-degree angle to engage your chest and triceps more effectively
Perform the movement with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down

title: Decline Kneeling Push Up on Box
summary: Begin by placing your knees on a box and position your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart
steps: Begin by placing your knees on a box and position your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart
Engage your chest and ensure your body forms a straight line from your head to your knees
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them at a 45-degree angle to your body
Push through your hands to return to the starting position, straightening your arms. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions

title: Decline Levitating Sit Ups Bodyweight
summary: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet secured under the footpads. Position your torso so it is parallel to the floor, 'levitating' off the bench
steps: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet secured under the footpads. Position your torso so it is parallel to the floor, 'levitating' off the bench
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, keeping your back straight and avoiding pulling on your neck
Lower your upper body back to the starting position with control, maintaining the parallel position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them
Ensure your lower back remains off the bench and parallel to the floor to engage your core muscles effectively
Use a stable decline bench to prevent any movement or slipping during the exercise

title: Decline Push Up
summary: Begin by placing your feet on a bench and position your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart
steps: Begin by placing your feet on a bench and position your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart
Engage your core and ensure your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them at a 45-degree angle to your body
Push through your hands to return to the starting position, straightening your arms. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain a straight body line and avoid sagging your hips
Use a stable chair or bench to prevent any movement or slipping during the exercise
Perform the movement with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury

title: Decline Push Up Against Wall
summary: Begin by placing your feet against a wall and positioning your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart. Your body should be in a decline position with your feet elevated on the wall
steps: Begin by placing your feet against a wall and positioning your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart. Your body should be in a decline position with your feet elevated on the wall
Engage your core and ensure your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them at a 45-degree angle to your body
Push through your hands to return to the starting position, straightening your arms. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Ensure your hands are positioned directly under your shoulders when you lower yourself
Perform the movement with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down
Use a stable wall to ensure your feet remain securely in place throughout the exercise

title: Decline Shoulder Tap
summary: Begin by placing your feet on a bench and positioning your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart. Your body should be in a decline position with your feet elevated
steps: Begin by placing your feet on a bench and positioning your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart. Your body should be in a decline position with your feet elevated
Engage your core and ensure your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels
Lift your right hand off the floor and tap your left shoulder, lightly rotate your hips according to the tap side
Return your right hand to the floor and repeat the movement with your left hand, tapping your right shoulder. Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain a straight body line and avoid sagging your hips
Avoid letting your shoulders sag; keep them stable and aligned with your hands
Use a stable bench to prevent any movement or slipping during the exercise

title: Decline Sit Up
summary: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet secured under the footpads. Position yourself so that your hips are at the edge of the bench
steps: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet secured under the footpads. Position yourself so that your hips are at the edge of the bench
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees until your torso forms a 90 degree angle with your thighs, keeping your back as straight as possible
Lower your upper body back to the starting position with control. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your shoulders
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them

title: Decline Sit Ups Dumbbells
summary: Secure your feet at the end of a decline bench and lie back with your knees slightly bent. Hold a dumbbell in each hand close to your chest
steps: Secure your feet at the end of a decline bench and lie back with your knees slightly bent. Hold a dumbbell in each hand close to your chest
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the bench by contracting your abdominal muscles
Continue to lift your upper body until you are in a seated position, ensuring that the contraction is felt in your abs
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position with control, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your body, rather than relying on momentum
Breathe out as you sit up and breathe in as you return to the starting position
Keep your feet securely anchored to the bench to stabilize your body throughout the exercise

title: Deep Push-up
summary: Begin in a plank position with your hands holding dumbbells on the floor, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Your feet should be on the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your heels
steps: Begin in a plank position with your hands holding dumbbells on the floor, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Your feet should be on the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your heels
Engage your core and ensure your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, allowing your chest to go deeper than your hands
Push through your hands to return to the starting position, straightening your arms. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain a straight body line and avoid sagging your hips
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down
Perform the movement with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury

title: Diagonal Chop Cable
summary: Anchor one end of the band at chest height. Stand with your right side facing the anchor point, with your feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp the handle with both hands. Extend your arms to hold the handle opposite your chest
steps: Anchor one end of the band at chest height. Stand with your right side facing the anchor point, with your feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp the handle with both hands. Extend your arms to hold the handle opposite your chest
Pull the handle down and diagonally across your body, twisting your torso and pivoting your back foot to follow through. Bring the handle down towards the left side
Slowly return to the starting position with control
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides to work in the opposite direction
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk
Exhale as you pull the handle down and across your body, and inhale as you return to the starting position
Use a lighter weight if needed to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger

title: Diagonal Chop Left
summary: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping your hands together and holding them extended opposite your chest
steps: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping your hands together and holding them extended opposite your chest
Rotate your torso and simultaneously bring your hands diagonally across your body towards your left hip, bending your knees slightly as you turn
Keep your arms extended and pivot your right foot as you rotate to protect your knee from strain
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner, bringing your hands back opposite your chest
tips: Engage your core throughout the movement to stabilize your spine and enhance power
Pivot on your feet during the rotation to ensure a full range of motion and to reduce stress on your knees
Focus on exhaling as you chop down and inhaling as you return to the starting position
Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the exercise to aid in balance and prevent strain on your joints

title: Diagonal Chop Right
summary: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping your hands together and holding them extended oposite your chest
steps: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping your hands together and holding them extended oposite your chest
Rotate your torso and simultaneously bring your hands diagonally across your body towards your right hip, bending your knees slightly as you turn
Keep your arms extended and pivot your right foot as you rotate to protect your knee from strain
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner, bringing your hands back opposite your chest
tips: Engage your core throughout the movement to stabilize your spine and enhance power
Pivot on your feet during the rotation to ensure a full range of motion and to reduce stress on your knees
Focus on exhaling as you chop down and inhaling as you return to the starting position
Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the exercise to aid in balance and prevent strain on your joints

title: Diagonal Lunge
summary: Stand with your feet together, arms extended outwards at shoulder level
steps: Stand with your feet together, arms extended outwards at shoulder level

Step diagonally forward with your right foot, planting it at a 45-degree angle. As you lower into a lunge, rotate your torso to the right and lean down to touch your right foot with your left hand, keeping your left leg straight
Press through your right heel and rotate back to center as you return to the starting position
Repeat the movement with your left leg, stepping diagonally forward, rotating left, and touching your left foot with your right hand
tips: Maintain your arms extended at shoulder level throughout the exercise to help with balance and increase the workout intensity
Rotate your torso smoothly and keep your movements controlled to avoid any jerky motions that might cause injury
Ensure that your lunging knee does not extend past your toes to protect your knee joint

title: Diagonal Opens
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms bent at the elbows, elbows facing outwards, and hands close to your chest
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms bent at the elbows, elbows facing outwards, and hands close to your chest
Slide your right hand over your left forearm, both arms in an opposite diagonal direction while keeping the elbows bent
Return your hands to the starting position and repeat the movement by sliding your left hand over your right forearm, extending in the opposite diagonal direction
tips: Ensure your movements are smooth and controlled to maintain tension and focus on muscle engagement
Focus on maintaining a rhythmic breathing pattern, inhaling as you extend and exhaling as you return to the start position
Maintain a slight tension in your core throughout the exercise to help stabilize your upper body

title: Diagonal Punch
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands in a guard position near your face
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands in a guard position near your face
Rotate your torso to the right, and extend your right arm in a diagonal punch across your body
Return your right hand to the starting position as you rotate your torso back to center
Repeat the motion with your left arm, rotating your torso to the left to execute a diagonal punch across your body
tips: Keep your hands up and elbows slightly bent when not punching to protect your face and maintain balance
Rotate your hips and shoulders fully with each punch to maximize power and engage your core muscles
Practice the punches slowly at first to ensure proper technique before increasing speed and power
Exhale sharply with each punch to increase force and stabilize your core

title: Diamond Push Up
summary: Begin in a plank position with your hands close together under your chest, fingers forming a diamond shape (thumbs and index fingers touching)
steps: Begin in a plank position with your hands close together under your chest, fingers forming a diamond shape (thumbs and index fingers touching)
Lower your body towards the floor, keeping your elbows close to your body and your back straight
Pause briefly as your chest nearly touches your hands
Push back up to the starting plank position, maintaining a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the movement
tips: Ensure your elbows do not flare out; they should stay close to your body to maximize triceps engagement
Control your descent and ascent to increase muscle tension and enhance strength gains
Breathe in as you lower down and exhale forcefully as you push back up to help power the movement
Keep your head in a neutral position, aligned with your spine, to avoid neck strain
Perform the push-up at a slow to moderate pace to focus on form and muscle engagement without rushing

title: Diamond Push-up (on Knees)
summary: Begin by kneeling on a mat with your hands close together under your chest on the floor, fingers forming a diamond shape (thumbs and index fingers touching)
steps: Begin by kneeling on a mat with your hands close together under your chest on the floor, fingers forming a diamond shape (thumbs and index fingers touching)
Lean forward to shift your weight onto your hands while keeping your back straight and your core engaged
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body
Press through your hands to lift your body back up to the starting position, maintaining the alignment of your spine throughout the movement
tips: Ensure your elbows point back rather than flaring out to the sides to maximize triceps activation and minimize shoulder strain
Keep your head and neck in a neutral position, aligned with your spine, to avoid any unnecessary strain
Breathe in as you lower yourself and exhale as you push back up, using your breath to help power the movement

title: Dip Leg Raise on Couch
summary: Sit on the edge of a couch with your hands placed next to your hips, gripping the edge for support
steps: Sit on the edge of a couch with your hands placed next to your hips, gripping the edge for support
Lift your hips off the couch by pressing down into your hands and straightening your arms, while keeping your feet flat on the floor and both knees bent
As you bend your elbows to lower your body into a dip, simultaneously lift one leg, bent at the knee, towards your chest
Push through your hands to raise your body back up, straightening your arms and simultaneously lowering your lifted leg back to the starting position
tips: Ensure your grip on the couch is secure to maintain balance and control throughout the exercise
Focus on a controlled, smooth motion both when lowering into the dip and lifting your body up to maximize muscle engagement
Keep the movement of your arms and legs coordinated; as you push up, lower the leg, and vice versa

title: Dip on Floor with Chair
summary: Sit on the floor with your back facing a chair and place your hands on the edge of the chair seat, fingers pointing towards your body
steps: Sit on the floor with your back facing a chair and place your hands on the edge of the chair seat, fingers pointing towards your body
Bend your knees in front of you with your heels resting on the floor
Press down into the chair with your hands to lift your hips off the floor, straightening your arms
Bend your elbows to lower your body towards the floor until your elbows form about a 90-degree angle and push through your hands to lift your body back up to the starting position
tips: Ensure your hands are firmly placed on the chair and your fingers are well-aligned for a strong grip
Keep your movements controlled and steady to engage the triceps effectively and avoid any jerky movements
Avoid dipping too low to prevent shoulder strain; stopping at a 90-degree elbow angle is generally safe and effective

title: Dips Between Chairs
summary: Position two chairs parallel to each other, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with the seats facing away from you
steps: Position two chairs parallel to each other, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with the seats facing away from you
Stand between the chairs and grasp the top of each chair back with your hands
Lift your body off the floor by straightening your arms, supporting your weight through your hands

Slowly lower your body by bending your elbows until they form about a 90-degree angle, keeping your body upright and close to the chair backs. Press through your hands to raise your body back to the starting position, extending your arms fully
tips: Check that the chairs are stable and strong enough to support your weight without tipping or moving
Keep your movements controlled and steady, focusing on using your triceps to lift and lower your body
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to keep tension on the muscles and protect your joints

title: Donkey Calf Raise
summary: Stand on the edge of a step with your heels hanging off, placing your forefeet securely on the step
steps: Stand on the edge of a step with your heels hanging off, placing your forefeet securely on the step
Lean forward and reach down to hold onto a bench in front of you for stability, keeping your back straight and hips aligned with your feet
Press down through your forefeet to elevate your heels as high as possible, fully contracting your calf muscles
Slowly lower your heels below the level of the step to maximize the stretch in your calves before the next lift
tips: Ensure your grip on the bench is secure to maintain balance and focus the effort on your calves
Keep your back flat and avoid rounding your shoulders to prevent unnecessary strain on your back
Emphasize the upward and downward movements equally to enhance muscle growth and strength in your calves
Maintain a slow, controlled pace to increase the intensity of the muscle contraction and effectiveness of the exercise

title: Donkey Kicks Bodyweight
summary: Begin on all fours in a tabletop position with your knees hip-width apart on the floor, hands under your shoulders, and your back flat
steps: Begin on all fours in a tabletop position with your knees hip-width apart on the floor, hands under your shoulders, and your back flat
Keeping your knee bent at a 90-degree angle, lift your right leg up towards the ceiling, driving your heel upward as if pushing against the sky
Push your leg up until your thigh is in line with your body and your foot is above your knee
Lower your leg slowly back to the starting position without letting your knee touch the floor. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the left leg
tips: Ensure your movements are controlled and deliberate to maximize glute activation and minimize momentum
Keep your neck and spine in a neutral position by gazing down at the floor
Avoid swinging your leg or using jerky movements; the power should come from your glutes and not from momentum

title: Doorway Biceps Curl
summary: Stand in a doorway and grip the sides of the door frame at about hip height, palms facing forward or slightly inward depending on comfort and doorway design
steps: Stand in a doorway and grip the sides of the door frame at about hip height, palms facing forward or slightly inward depending on comfort and doorway design
Step forward with one foot to create tension in your arms and lean slightly back, so your body weight helps create resistance
Curl your elbows to raise your body slowly towards the door frame, keeping your elbows pinned at your sides
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position, repeat the movement
tips: Ensure your grip is firm and your hands are positioned comfortably to avoid strain on your wrists
Keep your body straight and avoid swinging; the motion should come solely from your biceps
Adjust the position of your feet to increase or decrease resistance—the further you step and lean back, the harder the curl

title: Double Jump Squat
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands close together in front of your torso. Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and your weight in your heels. Stand back up to the starting position
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands close together in front of your torso. Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up and your weight in your heels. Stand back up to the starting position
Immediately lower into a squat again and then explosively jump up from the squat
Land softly on your feet after the jump, repeat the sequence
tips: Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement to maintain proper form and avoid injury
Perform the jumps in a fluid motion, transitioning smoothly between the squats and jumps
Focus on landing softly to reduce impact on your joints

title: Double Knee Drive
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, both arms bent and raised by your sides
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, both arms bent and raised by your sides
Lift your right knee towards your chest while rotating your torso to the right, bringing your left elbow to touch your right knee twice
Lower your right leg back to the starting position and return your torso to face forward

Repeat the movement on the opposite side by lifting your left knee towards your chest, rotating your torso to the left, and bringing your right elbow to touch your left knee twice. Continue alternating sides
tips: Keep your upper body upright and avoid leaning too far forward or backward to maintain balance and proper form
Engage your core muscles to stabilize your body and enhance the rotational movement
Focus on a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern, exhaling as you bring your knee and elbow together

title: Double Punch Front Leg Lift
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands in fists near your sides with cloesd fists
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands in fists near your sides with cloesd fists
Simultaneously punch forward with both arms while lifting your right leg slightly bent at the knee to about waist height
Return your arms and right leg to the starting position
Immediately repeat the movement, this time lifting your left leg while simultaneously punching forward with both arms. Continue alternating leg lifts with each set of punches
tips: Ensure your punches are strong and controlled, extending fully without locking your elbows
Maintain a slight bend in the lifted leg to reduce strain and enhance control during the movement
Focus on a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern, exhaling as you punch and lift your leg, and inhaling as you return to the starting position

title: Downward Dog Sprint
summary: Get down on your fours and raise your hips while keeping your arms and legs straight to form an inverted V-shape
steps: Get down on your fours and raise your hips while keeping your arms and legs straight to form an inverted V-shape
Raise and lower your feet alternately as if you are sprinting
Continue for a suitable duration

title: Drag Curl Dumbbell
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip (palms facing up). Let your arms hang straight down by your sides
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip (palms facing up). Let your arms hang straight down by your sides
Begin by dragging the dumbbells upward along your torso by bending your elbows and pulling them back, as if you are zipping up your jacket
Continue lifting the dumbbells until they reach chest height, focusing on squeezing your biceps at the top of the movement
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the descent. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Focus on the mind-muscle connection, feeling the contraction in your biceps throughout the movement
Use a weight that allows you to perform the exercise with proper form without straining
Avoid using momentum; perform the exercise in a slow and controlled manner

title: Drag Curl Resistance Band
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a resistance band under your feet. Hold the handles of the band with both hands, palms facing forward
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a resistance band under your feet. Hold the handles of the band with both hands, palms facing forward
Keep your elbows close to your body and your back straight. Start with your arms fully extended down at your sides
Curl the handles up by dragging your elbows along your torso, keeping them close to your torso, until your hands reach chest level
Slowly lower the handles back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Exhale as you curl the handles up and inhale as you lower them back down
Use a lighter resistance band if needed to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger
Focus on engaging your biceps throughout the movement

title: Dumbbell Ab Crunch
summary: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Hold a dumbbell with both hands striaght over your chest
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Hold a dumbbell with both hands striaght over your chest
Lift your head, shoulders, and upper back off the floor by contracting your abdominal muscles
Raise the dumbbell towards the ceiling as you perform the crunch, keeping your arms straight. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position, keeping control of the movement. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your lower back pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to avoid straining it
Avoid using your neck muscles to lift your head; focus on using your abdominal muscles
Breathe out as you lift your upper body and breathe in as you lower it

title: Dumbbell Alternate Bench Press (high Start)
summary: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand. Start with both arms extended straight up over your chest, palms facing forward
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand. Start with both arms extended straight up over your chest, palms facing forward
Lower the right dumbbell towards your chest by bending your elbow while keeping the left arm extended and stable
Press the right dumbbell back to the starting position by extending your elbow and contracting your chest muscles
Repeat the movement with the left arm while keeping the right arm extended and stable. Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Lower the dumbbell in a controlled manner to avoid using momentum
Breathe out as you press the dumbbell up and breathe in as you lower it down
Ensure your feet remain flat on the floor to maintain stability

title: Dumbbell Alternate Biceps Curl
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides and palms facing inwards
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides and palms facing inwards

Keep your elbows close to your torso and curl the right dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps. Rotate your forearm as you lift the dumbbell so that your palm faces your shoulder at the top of the movement
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position
Repeat the movement with your left arm while keeping the right arm extended. Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your elbows stationary and close to your torso to isolate the biceps
Avoid using momentum or swinging your body to lift the dumbbells
Breathe out as you curl the dumbbell up and breathe in as you lower it

title: Dumbbell Alternate Biceps Curl (version 2)
summary: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides and palms facing inwards
steps: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides and palms facing inwards

Keep your elbows close to your torso and curl the right dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps. Rotate your forearm as you lift the dumbbell so that your palm faces your shoulder at the top of the movement
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position
Repeat the movement with your left arm while keeping the right arm extended. Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your elbows stationary and close to your torso to isolate the biceps
Avoid using momentum or swinging your body to lift the dumbbells
Breathe out as you curl the dumbbell up and breathe in as you lower it

title: Dumbbell Alternate Seated Hammer Curl
summary: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides. Your palms should face each other (neutral grip)
steps: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended by your sides. Your palms should face each other (neutral grip)
Engage your core and keep your elbows close to your torso. Slowly curl the right dumbbell up towards your shoulder, maintaining the neutral grip with your palm facing inward
Squeeze your bicep at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control
Repeat the same motion with your left arm, alternating between right and left arms for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your wrists straight to avoid putting unnecessary strain on them during the curls
Maintain a controlled pace to ensure that you're using muscle strength rather than momentum
Visualize the bicep contraction to enhance the mind-muscle connection for better results

title: Dumbbell Alternate Shoulder Press
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Your palms should be facing forward, and your elbows should be bent at a 90-degree angle
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Your palms should be facing forward, and your elbows should be bent at a 90-degree angle
Engage your core and press the right dumbbell overhead until your arm is fully extended. Keep your left dumbbell in the starting position
Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder height in a controlled manner
Repeat, alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to maintain tension in the muscles
Breathe out as you press the dumbbell overhead and breathe in as you lower it
Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms throughout the exercise

title: Dumbbell Alternate Side Press
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Your palms should be facing each other, and your elbows should be bent at a 60-degree angle and facing downward
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Your palms should be facing each other, and your elbows should be bent at a 60-degree angle and facing downward
Press the right dumbbell overhead and slightly lean to the opposite side until your arm is fully extended
Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder height in a controlled manner and press the left dumbbell overhead and slightly to the side
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions, ensuring a smooth and controlled movement
tips: Breathe out as you press the dumbbell overhead and breathe in as you lower it
Maintain a controlled pace to maximize muscle engagement and avoid using momentum
Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms throughout the exercise

title: Dumbbell Armpit Row
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended and palms facing your body
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended and palms facing your body
Pull the dumbbells up towards your armpits by bending your elbows. Your elbows should be pointing out to the sides

Close your knees to bring the bars together

title: Seated Normal Grip Row Machine
summary: Sit on a bench facing a row machine with a straight back and your feet placed on the footrests
steps: Sit on a bench facing a row machine with a straight back and your feet placed on the footrests
Hold the rod above your knees with an overhand grip of your hands while keeping your arms straight
Pull the cable towards your chest by bending your arms and taking your elbows past your back
Return to the initial position and repeat

title: Seated Resistance Band - Cable Rows
summary: Sit on the floor with your legs fully extended and feet together, anchoring the resistance band around the soles of your feet. Hold the handles with both hands, arms extended forward, palms facing each other
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs fully extended and feet together, anchoring the resistance band around the soles of your feet. Hold the handles with both hands, arms extended forward, palms facing each other
Keep your back straight, chest up, and core engaged to stabilize your body
Pull the handles towards your torso by bending your elbows, keeping your arms close to your body. Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position, maintaining control over the resistance band. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid slouching to maintain proper form
Engage your core to prevent any rocking or unnecessary movement during the exercise
Use a controlled motion to pull and release the resistance band, avoiding jerking movements

title: Seated Shoulder Flexor Depressor Retractor Stretch
summary: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your back straight
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your back straight
Extend both arms down to your sides, then lean back slightly
Bring both arms about a foot behind you, keeping them straight, and place your hands on the floor with your fingers pointing forward
Hold this position for 15-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your shoulders. Slowly return to the starting position

tips: Ensure your arms remain straight and your hands are firmly placed on the floor to maximize the stretch in your shoulders

title: Seated Shoulder Press Barbell
summary: Sit on a bench with a backrest, feet flat on the floor. Hold a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing forward), hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Rest the barbell on your upper chest
steps: Sit on a bench with a backrest, feet flat on the floor. Hold a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing forward), hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Rest the barbell on your upper chest
Press the barbell overhead by extending your elbows, keeping your back firmly against the backrest
Fully extend your arms at the top of the movement, ensuring the barbell is directly above your head
Lower the barbell back down to your upper chest with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms to avoid strain
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to protect your joints
Exhale as you press the barbell up and inhale as you lower it down

title: Seated Side Stretch
summary: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight
steps: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight
Extend your right arm overhead, keeping your left hand holding on the bench for support
Lean your torso to the left, reaching your right arm over your head and to the left side, feeling the stretch along the right side of your body
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then slowly return to the starting position. Repeat on the other side by extending your left arm overhead and leaning to the right
tips: Move into the stretch gradually, ensuring that your movements are controlled to avoid muscle strain
Ensure your supporting hand is firmly placed on the bench to maintain stability
Perform the stretch on a stable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort

title: Seated Single Leg Hamstring Stretch
summary: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you
Bend your left knee and place the sole of your left foot against your right inner thigh. Keep your right leg extended and straight
Reach forward with both hands towards your right foot, keeping your back straight. Aim to grasp your toes or reach as far as comfortable

Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your right hamstring. Slowly release and return to the starting position. Repeat on the other side by extending your left leg and bending your right knee

title: Seated V Up

steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your arms placed on the floor slightly behind you for support

Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing your abdominal muscles
Lower your legs and torso back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift into the V position and inhaling as you lower back down
Avoid using momentum to lift your legs and torso; focus on using your abdominal muscles
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders to maintain proper form

title: Shadow Boxing
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, one foot slightly in front of the other, and your knees slightly bent. Position your hands in front of your face in a guard position, with your elbows close to your body
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, one foot slightly in front of the other, and your knees slightly bent. Position your hands in front of your face in a guard position, with your elbows close to your body
Begin throwing punches in the air, alternating between jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts. Use a full range of motion and rotate your hips and shoulders to generate power
Move around as you throw your punches, incorporating footwork to simulate a real boxing match. Step forward, backward, and side to side, keeping light on your feet
Continue shadow boxing for the desired duration, maintaining a steady pace and controlled movements
tips: Focus on proper form and technique with each punch to maximize effectiveness and prevent injury
Breathe steadily, exhaling with each punch and inhaling between movements
Keep your hands up in the guard position to protect your face, even while moving and throwing punches
Use your lower body to generate power, rotating your hips and pivoting on your feet with each punch
Maintain a light and agile stance, allowing you to move quickly and fluidly

title: Shoulder Abduction
summary: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides
Slowly raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, forming a T shape with your body. Keep your palms facing down and your elbows slightly bent
Hold the position for a moment, feeling the activation in your shoulders
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Move your arms slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you raise your arms and inhaling as you lower them
Ensure your shoulders stay relaxed and away from your ears throughout the movement
Avoid using momentum to lift your arms; focus on using your shoulder muscles

title: Shoulder Circle
summary: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms relaxed, hanging straight down by your sides
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms relaxed, hanging straight down by your sides
Begin by making small circular motions with your shoulders, moving them backward in a controlled manner
Gradually increase the size of the circles, maintaining a steady pace
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Move your shoulders slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you complete each circle and inhaling as you start the next
Avoid using momentum to move your shoulders; focus on using your shoulder muscles

title: Shoulder Extension
summary: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms straight by your sides
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms straight by your sides

tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you raise your arms overhead and inhaling as you lower them back down
Ensure your shoulders stay relaxed and away from your ears throughout the movement

title: Side Lunges Bodyweight
summary: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your hands clasped in front of you for balance
steps: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your hands clasped in front of you for balance
Take a big step to the right with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position. Your right knee should be bent and your left leg should remain straight
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position
Repeat on the other side by stepping out to the left with your left foot, lowering into a lunge, and then returning to the starting position
tips: Ensure your knee does not extend past your toes in the lunge position to protect your knee joint
Maintain a straight back and avoid leaning forward excessively during the lunge
Breathe steadily, inhaling as you step out and lower into the lunge, and exhaling as you push back to the starting position

title: Side Lying Floor Stretch
summary: Lie on your left side with your legs stacked on top of each other and your body in a straight line. Rest your head on your left arm
steps: Lie on your left side with your legs stacked on top of each other and your body in a straight line. Rest your head on your left arm

tips: Ensure your extended arm stays straight to maximize the stretch in your back and shoulders
Keep your core engaged to support your lower back during the stretch
Perform the stretch on a comfortable, non-slip surface to ensure safety and reduce discomfort

title: Side Lying Leg Lift Left
summary: Lie on your right side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Rest your head on your right arm and place your left hand on your hips
steps: Lie on your right side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Rest your head on your right arm and place your left hand on your hips
Slowly lift your left leg straight up towards the ceiling, keeping it straight and in line with your body
Hold the top position for a moment, feeling the contraction in your outer thigh and hip
Slowly lower your leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left side and perform the exercise with your right leg
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it
Ensure your leg stays straight and in line with your body throughout the movement
Avoid using momentum to lift your leg; focus on using your hip and thigh muscles

title: Side Lying Leg Lift Right

steps: Lie on your left side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Rest your head on your left arm and place your right hand on your hips
Slowly lift your right leg straight up towards the ceiling, keeping it straight and in line with your body
Hold the top position for a moment, feeling the contraction in your outer thigh and hip
Slowly lower your leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your right side and perform the exercise with your left leg
tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your leg and inhaling as you lower it
Ensure your leg stays straight and in line with your body throughout the movement
Avoid using momentum to lift your leg; focus on using your hip and thigh muscles

title: Side Plank
summary: Lie on your right side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder
steps: Lie on your right side with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder

Hold the position for the desired duration, keeping your body straight and your core tight
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat on the other side by lying on your left side and following the same steps
tips: Ensure your elbow is directly under your shoulder to support your upper body

title: Side Plank Oblique Crunch
summary: Begin in a side plank position on your right side, with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder. Place your left hand on your hip

Lower your hips towards the floor without touching it, then raise them back up to the starting position, squeezing your obliques at the top
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other side and perform the exercise on your left side
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain balance and stability
Move your hips slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury

title: Side Plank with Hip Lift
summary: Begin in a side plank position on your right side, with your legs extended straight and stacked on top of each other. Prop yourself up on your right elbow, keeping your elbow directly under your shoulder. Raise your left arm straight toward the ceiling

Lower your hips back to the floor without touching it and repeat the steps for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other side and perform the exercise on your left side

Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them

title: Side to Side Punch
summary: Stand upright with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Hold your fists up in front of your face in a guard position
steps: Stand upright with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Hold your fists up in front of your face in a guard position
Rotate your torso to the left as you punch across your body with your right hand, extending your arm fully. Keep your legs and hips stationary
Quickly return to the starting position, then rotate your torso to the right as you punch across your body with your left hand
Continue alternating punches from side to side for the desired duration or number of repetitions, maintaining a steady rhythm and controlled movements
tips: Focus on rotating your torso to generate power in your punches while keeping your legs and hips stationary
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you punch and inhaling as you return to the starting position

tips: Breathe steadily, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower back down

title: Side Wrist Pull Stretch

Use a weight that provides enough resistance to challenge your muscles without compromising form

title: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat

tips: Ensure your bent knee does not extend past your toes to avoid unnecessary strain on the knee joint

steps: Stand in the center of a trap bar with your feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees and hips to lower your body, and grasp the handles of the trap bar with a neutral grip (palms facing in)
Stand up straight with the trap bar at arm's length by your sides, keeping your core engaged and back straight
Lift your shoulders towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top of the movement
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you shrug your shoulders and inhale as you lower them
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid straining it during the movement
Ensure your back remains straight and avoid leaning forward or backward

title: Treadmill Jogging
summary: Stand on the treadmill with your feet on the side rails and attach the safety clip to your clothing. Start the treadmill at a low speed to safely step onto the belt
steps: Stand on the treadmill with your feet on the side rails and attach the safety clip to your clothing. Start the treadmill at a low speed to safely step onto the belt
Once you are on the moving belt, gradually increase the speed to a comfortable jogging pace, maintaining an upright posture with your core engaged
Keep your arms bent at a 90-degree angle, swinging them naturally at your sides to match your jogging rhythm
Maintain a steady pace, landing mid-foot with each stride and keeping your breathing steady. Jog for the desired duration or distance
tips: Keep your head up and gaze forward, avoiding looking down at your feet
Use a smooth, natural stride to reduce the impact on your joints
Ensure the treadmill speed is set at a comfortable level that allows you to maintain good form

title: Treadmill Running
summary: Stand on the treadmill with your feet on the side rails and attach the safety clip to your clothing. Start the treadmill at a low speed to safely step onto the belt
steps: Stand on the treadmill with your feet on the side rails and attach the safety clip to your clothing. Start the treadmill at a low speed to safely step onto the belt
Once you are on the moving belt, gradually increase the speed to a running pace, maintaining an upright posture with your core engaged
Keep your arms bent at a 90-degree angle, swinging them naturally at your sides to match your running rhythm
Maintain a steady pace, landing mid-foot with each stride and keeping your breathing steady. Run for the desired duration or distance
tips: Keep your head up and gaze forward, avoiding looking down at your feet
Use a smooth, natural stride to reduce the impact on your joints
Ensure the treadmill speed is set at a comfortable level that allows you to maintain good form

title: Tricep Cable Kickback on Crossover Machine
summary: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, and set the cable at a low position. Hold the cable end in one hand and bend slightly forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent
steps: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, and set the cable at a low position. Hold the cable end in one hand and bend slightly forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent
Position your upper arm parallel to the floor with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle, keeping your elbow close to your side
Extend your arm backward by straightening your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary, and only moving your forearm
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbow. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms

Keep your upper arm stationary throughout the exercise to ensure proper form

title: Tricep Extension Machine
summary: Sit on the tricep extension machine, adjusting the seat height so that your upper arms comfortably rest on the arm pad, with your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle
steps: Sit on the tricep extension machine, adjusting the seat height so that your upper arms comfortably rest on the arm pad, with your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle
Grasp the handles with a neutral grip, ensuring your elbows are below the pivot point
Push the handles forward by straightening your elbows and fully extending your arms while keeping your upper arms stationary
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbows. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you return to the starting position
Focus on using your triceps to push the handles, avoiding excessive use of your shoulders or back
Keep your upper arms stationary on the pad to ensure proper form

title: Triceps Dip Machine
summary: Sit down on the triceps dip machine and place your feet flat on the floor. Adjust the seat height so that your upper arms are parallel to the floor when you grasp the handles
steps: Sit down on the triceps dip machine and place your feet flat on the floor. Adjust the seat height so that your upper arms are parallel to the floor when you grasp the handles
Grip the handles firmly, keeping your elbows bent and close to your sides. Slightly lean your torso forward
Push the handles downward by straightening your elbows and extending your arms fully while keeping your upper arms stationary
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Keep your elbows close to your sides throughout the exercise to ensure proper form
Avoid locking your elbows completely at the end of the movement to maintain tension in your triceps
Use a weight that allows you to maintain control and proper form throughout the exercise

title: Triceps Light Stretch
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and raise your right arm at chest height across your chest, bending your elbow
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and raise your right arm at chest height across your chest, bending your elbow
Use your left hand to gently grab your right elbow, pulling it across your chest to deepen the stretch in your triceps
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle stretch in your triceps
Release the stretch and repeat with your left arm. Perform the stretch for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Avoid twisting your torso; keep it stable and facing forward
Breathe deeply and steadily, relaxing into the stretch
Do not pull too hard; the stretch should be gentle and not cause pain

title: Upper Back Stretch
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, rounding your upper back and pushing your hands forward
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, rounding your upper back and pushing your hands forward
Lower both arms backward, bringing them to your sides just past behind your hips
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle squeeze in your upper back and shoulder blades
Release and repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Breathe deeply and steadily, relaxing into the stretch
Avoid shrugging your shoulders up towards your ears; keep them relaxed
Do not overextend your arms; the stretch should be gentle and not cause pain

title: Upright Row Barbell
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed shoulder-width apart. Allow the barbell to rest against your thighs with your arms fully extended
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed shoulder-width apart. Allow the barbell to rest against your thighs with your arms fully extended
Pull the barbell upward along the front of your body by bending your elbows and lifting your upper arms
Continue lifting the barbell until it reaches chest height, keeping your elbows higher than your wrists throughout the movement
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position by extending your arms fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Lead with your elbows to ensure proper muscle engagement and avoid wrist strain
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift the barbell and inhaling as you lower it back down
Avoid using momentum or swinging your body to lift the barbell

title: Upright Row Cable Resistance Band
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of a resistance band, holding a handle in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing back). Ensure the band is taut when your arms are extended downwards
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of a resistance band, holding a handle in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing back). Ensure the band is taut when your arms are extended downwards
Lift the handles straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows and keeping the band close to your body
Raise the handles until your elbows are slightly higher than your shoulders and pointing to your sides
Slowly lower the handles back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift the handles and inhale as you lower them
Use a resistance band that allows you to maintain control and proper form throughout the exercise
Avoid lifting the handles too high, which can put unnecessary strain on your shoulder joints

title: Upright Row Dumbbell
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing your thighs). Let the dumbbells rest against your thighs
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip (palms facing your thighs). Let the dumbbells rest against your thighs
Lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows and keeping the weights close to your body
Raise the dumbbells until your elbows are level with your shoulders, ensuring your upper arms are parallel to the floor
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them
Focus on using your shoulders and upper back to lift the dumbbells, avoiding excessive use of your biceps
Avoid lifting the dumbbells too high, which can put unnecessary strain on your shoulder joints

title: Upright Row Ez Bar
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ Bar with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed shoulder-width apart. Allow the barbell to rest against your thighs with your arms fully extended
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ Bar with an overhand grip (palms facing down), hands placed shoulder-width apart. Allow the barbell to rest against your thighs with your arms fully extended
Pull the EZ Bar upward along the front of your body by bending your elbows and lifting your upper arms
Continue lifting the EZ Bar until it reaches chest height, keeping your elbows higher than your wrists throughout the movement
Slowly lower the EZ Bar back to the starting position by extending your arms fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Lead with your elbows to ensure proper muscle engagement and avoid wrist strain
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift the barbell and inhaling as you lower it back down
Avoid using momentum or swinging your body to lift the EZ Bar

title: Upward Rotation Bent Arms
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms bent at 90 degrees with your upper arms parallel to the floor, and your forearms pointing down to the floor
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms bent at 90 degrees with your upper arms parallel to the floor, and your forearms pointing down to the floor
Rotate your forearms upwards until your fingers point towards the ceiling, keeping your upper arms stationary
Slowly rotate them back to the starting position
Repeat for the desired repetitions
tips: Focus on using your shoulder muscles to rotate your arms, avoiding excessive use of your neck or back
Keep your upper arms stationary throughout the movement to ensure proper form
Lift your arms as high as comfortable, to avoid unnecessary strain on your shoulder joints

title: V Bar Lat Pull Down
summary: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor and knees secured under the pads. Grasp the V-bar attached to the machine, arms fully extended above you, and hands shoulder-width apart
steps: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor and knees secured under the pads. Grasp the V-bar attached to the machine, arms fully extended above you, and hands shoulder-width apart
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest and bring your elbows downwards
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom of the movement
Slowly return the V-bar to the starting position. Repeat for the desired repetitions
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you pull the bar down and inhale as you return to the starting position
Focus on using your back muscles to pull the bar, avoiding excessive use of your arms
Keep your wrists straight and avoid bending them during the pull to prevent strain

title: V Crunches
summary: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms extended on the floor overhead
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms extended on the floor overhead
Simultaneously lift your legs and torso off the floor, reaching your hands towards your feet to form a 'V' shape with your body
Squeeze your abdominal muscles at the top of the movement, ensuring your hands reach towards your feet
Slowly lower your legs and torso back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift into the 'V' position and inhale as you lower back down
Avoid using momentum to lift your legs and torso; focus on using your abdominal muscles
Keep your legs and arms straight throughout the movement for maximum effectiveness

title: V Up
summary: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs and arms extended so that your body forms a straight line
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs and arms extended so that your body forms a straight line
Simultaneously lift your legs and torso off the floor, reaching your hands towards your feet to form a 'V' shape with your body
Squeeze your abdominal muscles at the top of the movement, ensuring your hands reach towards your feet
Slowly lower your legs and torso back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift into the 'V' position and inhale as you lower back down
Avoid using momentum to lift your legs and torso; focus on using your abdominal muscles
Keep your legs and arms straight throughout the movement for maximum effectiveness

title: Walking
summary: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides
steps: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides
Step forward with your right foot, rolling through the heel to the ball of your foot while swinging your left arm forward and right arm back
Push off with your right foot, bringing your left foot forward to step, swinging your right arm forward and left arm back
Continue this alternating pattern, maintaining a natural stride and rhythm. Repeat for the desired distance or time
tips: Swing your arms naturally in opposition to your legs to help with balance and momentum
Maintain a steady and comfortable pace that allows you to walk efficiently
Wear comfortable, supportive shoes to prevent injury and enhance your walking experience

title: Walking Fast
summary: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides
steps: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides
Step forward with your right foot, rolling through the heel to the ball of your foot while swinging your left arm forward and right arm back
Push off with your right foot, quickly bringing your left foot forward to step, swinging your right arm forward and left arm back. Increase your pace while maintaining control
Continue this alternating pattern, maintaining a brisk and consistent stride. Repeat for the desired distance or time
tips: Maintain a brisk pace that challenges you but allows you to walk efficiently
Wear comfortable, supportive shoes to prevent injury and enhance your walking experience
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid tensing your upper body

title: Walkout
summary: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed by your sides
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed by your sides
Bend your hips and knees to place your hands on the floor before you
Walk your hands forward, keeping your legs straight, until you are in a plank position with your hands under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels
Walk your hands back towards your feet, lifting your hips and forming an inverted V shape with your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Avoid letting your hips sag or rise too high when in the plank position
Keep your legs as straight as possible while walking your hands to and from the plank position
Use a mat to provide cushioning for your hands and prevent slipping

title: Wall Sit Bodyweight
summary: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, about 2 feet away from the wall
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, about 2 feet away from the wall
Slide your back down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor, and your knees are directly above your ankles
Hold this position, keeping your back flat against the wall and your hands relaxed by your sides or on your thighs
Maintain the position for the desired duration, then slowly stand back up
tips: Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to avoid placing unnecessary strain on your joints
Breathe steadily and avoid holding your breath during the exercise
Press your lower back firmly against the wall to ensure proper alignment

title: Wall Squat Bodyweight
summary: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, positioned a few inches away from the wall
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, positioned a few inches away from the wall
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and hips, allowing your buttocks to touch the wall first, then your entire torso
Immediately push through your heels to stand back up, returning to the starting position
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Start the movement by engaging your glutes and core to maintain stability
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes and do not extend past your toes to prevent strain on your knees
Move smoothly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury

title: Wall Squat with Pause Bodyweight
summary: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, about 2 feet away from the wall
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, about 2 feet away from the wall
Slide your back down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees are at a 90-degree angle, ensuring your knees are directly above your ankles
Pause for 5-10 seconds and then push through your heels to stand back up, sliding your back up the wall until you return to the starting position
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions
tips: Ensure your knees do not extend past your toes to avoid placing unnecessary strain on your joints
Breathe steadily: inhale as you lower into the squat and exhale as you stand back up
Press your lower back firmly against the wall to ensure proper alignment and support

title: Weighted Standing Shoulder Press with Plate
summary: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level, elbows bent and pointing down
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands at chest level, elbows bent and pointing down
Press the plate upward by extending your arms fully above your head, keeping your core tight and your back straight
Lower the plate back down to chest level in a controlled manner
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions
